name: White Knight — protection from black blocks black Aura but not non-targeting black effects
notes: Memory: project_protection_from_x_2026-04-25. A black Aura (Dead Weight) cannot enchant a creature with protection from black, so the Knight stays 2/2, while the same Aura on Bears works (0/0). Dread of Night is a non-targeting black effect and still gives the white Knight -1/-1.
